summary: Review for v0.2 is open. v0.2.1 incorporates the first Review feedback: the Define conversation asks the problem, current approach, value, and beneficiaries before the purpose (seeded planning/definition.md); suggestions go to planning/later.md; check.py --leaving refuses phase changes with proposed decisions or unanswered definitions; approvals are typed; one closeout question; Nokkvi's law encourages a frustrated person out loud. Acceptance test is the org opt-in install.

decisions.summary: Primary deliverable is an org-installable skill.
Adapters stay substantive and point at the skill; resume is a briefing.
Explicit invocation first; a hook offers the skill once per session on new work.
Problem framing (four questions) before purpose; recorded in planning/definition.md.
Principle: build only what you need; smallest version stated in definition.md.
Suggestions go to planning/later.md; proposals expire at phase close; one closeout question.
Approvals that shape the project are typed in the author's words, never clicked.
Nokkvi's law: brief outward encouragement when the person is frustrated or confused, then help.
Release 0.2.1 during Review with the feedback incorporated.

questions: Does Sean's next project, seeded by 0.2.1, get real answers to the four problem questions?
next_action: Push with tags; update the installed plugin; make it Available for install per docs/INSTALL.md; observe and record findings. Review continues until the author closes it.
